name: Schattenwart Wirklichso
personality: Can make a small object cast an impressively complete explanation.
visual_intent: Cave Shadow Puppeteer: tall hooked ink splat,small smoky-plum cave cap,ONE little hinged cream shadow screen held at flank with a simple inanimate flat bird-shaped cutout on short stick in other hand,no actual cave/extra puppet creature. Gleeful crooked grin with THREE upper teeth,one eyelid raised
biography: Can make a small object cast an impressively complete explanation. His HyperNorm screen turns a little cutout into the whole permitted world. A dissonant card asks what is holding the stick. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Gegenstand wurde seiner Erklärung entsprechend vergrößert.

name: Idealwart Makellos
personality: Disapproves of every example for failing to be the idea.
visual_intent: Ideal Form Statue interpreted black INK not stone human: squat broad symmetric-ish ink splat with deliberately uneven lobes,small ivory geometric cap,tiny stone medallion,ONE perfectly smooth golden sphere held on little plinth in goo hand,not standing on pedestal. Severe asymmetric closed toothless pout,one eye almost narrowed shut
biography: Disapproves of every example for failing to be the idea. His golden sphere condemns every HyperNorm example for being an example. A dissonant card enjoys the small dent his inspection overlooked. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Vorbild bedauert die Existenz seiner Ausführungen.

name: Gefangener Zweifach
personality: Has been told he is not alone and would like to inspect the arrangement.
visual_intent: Chained Prisoner Pair metaphor kept SIX actors total: ONE round top-heavy ink blob with TWO iron wrist cuffs linked by ONE short chain across own two goo hands,one extra EMPTY cuff dangling from small side loop as absent counterpart cue,no second prisoner. Huge unequal pleading eyes,small quivering toothless open mouth,whole blob upright
biography: Has been told he is not alone and would like to inspect the arrangement. His HyperNorm cuffs promise shared confinement while the spare cuff waits empty. A dissonant card asks whether company and captivity need the same chain. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Paarverhältnis ist einseitig bereits vollständig eingerichtet.

name: König Schlussendlich
personality: Has considered every objection that reached him in an approved form.
visual_intent: Philosopher King: tall broad-based pear blob,small crooked gold crown ABOVE eyes,tiny burgundy shoulder collar,ONE small closed ivory book held like final authority. Hooded side-eye,closed crooked toothless lip line,comically absolute patience
biography: Has considered every objection that reached him in an approved form. His closed HyperNorm book contains every objection allowed to reach the crown. A dissonant card knocks without first requesting a page number. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Einwände wurden bis zum zugelassenen Umfang erwogen.

name: Sophistin Glattweg
personality: Can make either side sound like the room's original intention.
visual_intent: Sophist Smooth Talker: broad lopsided round blob,small teal laurel headband,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE beautifully polished brass speaking horn held at flank and single blank rolled scroll. Enormous charming crooked open smile with TWO upper teeth,one eye knowingly narrowed
biography: Can make either side sound like the room's original intention. Her horn makes every HyperNorm position sound like the obvious common ground. A dissonant card asks why the ground moves when she speaks. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Einigkeit lässt sich mit passendem Ansatz darstellen.

name: Fackelführerin Vielleichtdort
personality: Shows the way while privately hoping the way has noticed.
visual_intent: Torch Bearer Guide: tall narrow curved blob,small rust traveller cap and short cream scarf,two subtle lashes,ONE short torch with one warm solid modeled orange clay flame held off to side within cell,no background fire or cave. One wide hopeful eye one anxious eye,nervous closed toothless smile
biography: Shows the way while privately hoping the way has noticed. Her torch leads HyperNorm neighbours toward a route she cannot promise. A dissonant card walks beside her rather than demanding certainty. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist beleuchtet, nicht abschließend belegt.
